description: REPEAT ... UNTIL (<condition>) END REPEAT - a POST-TEST loop executed in anonymous BEGIN...END blocks. The body runs AT LEAST ONCE, then iterates while the condition is false and stops once it becomes true; the run-at-least-once case is pinned with a condition that is ALREADY TRUE on entry, which is the only shape that distinguishes a post-test loop from a pre-test one. The UNTIL condition must be PARENTHESISED, as Snowflake requires. Accumulation across iterations and BREAK are pinned too. Converted 1:1 from scripting/RepeatUntilTest (now retired); the blocks are written on one line here, which the scripting parser reads identically.

steps.sql: BEGIN LET i INTEGER := 0; REPEAT i := i + 1; UNTIL (i >= 5) END REPEAT; RETURN i; END;
BEGIN LET i INTEGER := 10; LET runs INTEGER := 0; REPEAT runs := runs + 1; UNTIL (i >= 5) END REPEAT; RETURN runs; END;
BEGIN LET i INTEGER := 0; LET total INTEGER := 0; REPEAT i := i + 1; total := total + i; UNTIL (i >= 4) END REPEAT; RETURN total; END;
BEGIN LET i INTEGER := 0; REPEAT i := i + 1; IF (i = 3) THEN BREAK; END IF; UNTIL (i >= 100) END REPEAT; RETURN i; END;
